newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PEARCE TO KEEP FOREST JOB FOR REST OF SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PEARCE TO KEEP FOREST JOB FOR REST OF SEASON.

text.p: England defender Stuart Pearce will continue as player-manager of premier league side Nottingham Forest until at least the end of the season, the club said on Wednesday.

"Stuart will carry on in his current position until the end of the season and then we will talk again, or maybe even sooner," Forest chairman Irving Korn said after talks with Pearce earlier in the day.
Pearce, who has played over 500 matches for Forest, took over as caretaker player-manager in December when former manager Frank Clark resigned to join Manchester City.
Under his leadership, Forest have hauled themselves out of the relegation zone with five victories in their last seven matches.
